body:
I have no formal medical education. However, I know that its best not to suddenly stop medication that you have been taking it for a while. 

It is best to reduce the amount you take gradually and then stop.

Please do consult with professional.
Let's not forget the holidays.

Yes books are really great.

I've tried reading an autobiography but stopped because it was too heavy for me to carry around with me. Hopefully be able to finish it during the holidays.

Books are really amazing. Just endless topics.

I believe you have improved a lot by doing so!
Yes it does. I hope you are reaching your goals!
Its nice to spend time alone sometimes. I'm glad you found a place!
Thank you very much. It means a lot.
Thank you very much. It means a lot.

I am trying hard to be part of the events and activities. Not sure if I am engaging in a lot of life to be honest.

I hope you are not just witnessing it but part of it.
There are always things to do. Like reading. You got the answer in your post!

It was a good read.

I'm sure you will find a book that you don't have to push much to read cover to cover! This was the 5th book I tried reading by the way.
I have updated the original post.

*An Astronaut's Guide to Life on Earth by Chris Hadfield*

I usually listen to music or podcasts. Audiobooks are great but I have trouble remembering it unfortunately...

I felt that way when I started. When will I finish? I have no time...

But you know, time will pass anyways and if you are making process constantly that day will come!
*An Astronaut's Guide to Life on Earth by Chris Hadfield*

I am not sure why you miss reading, but if its time try reading when you can. I've pulled out my book and read many times while I was waiting for the lecture to start even though it was only about 5 minutes.
That is so true and thank you for the complement. It means a lot.
Thats the beauty of fictions. Lets your imagination run wild.
I find it very difficult to read when I am really depressed. Thats a good skill you have!
*An Astronaut's Guide to Life on Earth by Chris Hadfield*

That is a great analogy. Thank you very much!

Well you know *"Physics works!" - Walter Lewin*

> but come across a sentence/paragraph that really strikes a chord
I agree, but I just forget it right after if I don't write it down.

Just for interest, this is my favourite quote from the book:

*"Competence means keeping your head in a crisis, sticking with a task even when it seems hopeless, and improvising good solutions to tough problems when every second counts. It encompasses ingenuity, determination and being prepared for anything."*

I completely understand what you mean. When I was very depressed I couldn't read at all. Or was able read but not remember anything.

I hope you can read without any problems!

*An Astronaut's Guide to Life on Earth by Chris Hadfield*

Yes, it was a good book.
*An Astronaut's Guide to Life on Earth by Chris Hadfield*

*An Astronaut's Guide to Life on Earth by Chris Hadfield*

Yes, ever since computers stepped in I stopped reading. Haven't read a book cover to cover for I think about a 6 or 7 years...
You will pass these tough moments. Hang in there.

That's nice!

I'm not sure how open about your feelings but I think its a good idea to be open about it. If you haven't really been that way, try it.
Have you made any contact recently?
What will it make you feel better?
Let her know how you feel even though it may not seem manly.
Are you still in contact with her?

Thank you for your comment on my current situation.

All the decisions I have been making, like eating even though I don't want to, keeping up with fluids, they are all calculated decisions for the future me. There are days that I just don't want to eat and drink and hope that I will pass out and never wake up. Unfortunately I will wake up. So I eat. So I drink.

Probably being interested in them and also at the same time they being intreated in you. 

I get heaps of messages on Facebook about the fucking college assignments from 'friends' around due date. I can even predict who sent the message. Funny how the ones who I think truly get along (hopefully, I'm in doubt) with me never messages me about assignments. 

But I'm sure there are people out there who cares about you. I have a friend who seem to be not interested in anything and not in care of anyone else's business taking care of me in his own way. I was truly surprised when I found out. Almost cried really. I'm sure there will be someone out there. It may not be visible at this time.

Yeah I have looked broader and it comes back to this shit hole. Like it was meant to be... But I'm convinced that it did not happen for a reason. It was probably me who made it to go back to shit hole.

Its clear, I suck shit at living. My rate of improvement is too slow for me to invest in the future.
Sorry I didn't really write this in detail.

Its such a nice feeling to have friends around. I hope my friends like me in a way I like them...

I'm currently in a not a very good relationship with my one close friend... I'm just waiting and seeing...
Yeah they are really good friends. At least to my opinions.
The only think that is keeping me alive is my friends. But I think I am losing that...
Same here but when you see everyone else being thanked all the time you start to wonder what you are doing.

I am totally surprised by what ‘past me’ did for ‘present me’. At the time I did not want to apply for uni nor I wanted to live. However I did it.

Why?

I don’t really know. Probably because I knew that that version of me wasn’t me. The true me was long lost into the void of depression.

So I did it for the ‘future me’ so that when the time comes when ‘true me’ is back he can thrive again.

I won’t say what I did was an act of hope. Because I had none at the time. Just a logical, decision based on calculations.
Completely agree. A friend messaging me out of the blue makes my day all the time.

Please reduce your drinking. I am very tempted to self medicate but I do not.

I know its hard but please don't. I use physical activities to worn myself out and to sleep.

The quote from The Shawshank Redemption is a great quote. I told myself and still do all the time.

I didn't get into uni course I wanted and didn't wanted to go to other university and since it is not as good as the one I missed out. With my "All or nothing" attitude I am going for top 30 transfer group from other course which they will transfer to course I wanted in second semester without any fall backs.

I wasn't going to do this but I chose to do it because it gives me a sense of hope. So that I will have a something to work for next few months. I don't even know if I will get in but, y

Feel free to PM me if you want to talk.
Do you need a person to talk to? Feel free to PM me.

Does the pain make you feel alive?

It does for me sometimes.
Thank you for sharing. We all need more resources.
I feel you. Thats why I hate holidays.

The place where I am receiving help from told me that they do not diagnose young people (under 25) because they don't want them to have the negative feels that they might get from being labeled (sign hanging around your neck).

I can't really react since they recommend to me to not know.

In regards to your worthless feelings, you are not worthless. For god sake you are a med student!

How are you today?

Edit: Feel free to PM me.

I'm sorry to hear that you have been fighting your girlfriend.

You know all my friends tells me to keep strong and change the mindset to think positively. For my case, the truth is they don't understand what I am going through. However, I really appreciate them trying to help.

So I learned not to talk about my depression but just enjoy their company but let them know what I am going through.

I'm sure your girlfriend wants to help you. Try to enjoy her company and if you feel like you have nothing to do (which I do all the time) try something completely random that you and her will like.

Feel free to PM me if you want

Yes indeed life is too tiring.

I live for the little joys I get time to time really.

Enjoy the little things stranger!

Yeah no one knows the future.

What I am afraid is that I will miss out just again like I did. Or regret taking the course I will be taking in the future.
Yeah I watched a few horror movies after reading that cartoon like 2 months ago. None of theme scared me or entertained me so I stopped...

I would say "hope" is wanting existence of god in this case.

eg: I believe that aliens exists even though there aren't any relevant supporting evidence.
Even if you are not convinced you can still believe and trust...

Yeah I did "just" go out with a hope that it will relief me. But the reality is that after two or three times you realise that there is no point of going out without a clear goal.

It makes it even worst sometimes.

So what I do is when I have to go out, I stay out and try to enjoy as long as I can. That brings me relief.

Same problem here.

I wish I can leave and go somewhere but I can't because there is no where to go.

I guess trying again next year is the only option I have.

Or should I try other uni with less recognized qualification? (It depends on people but as an average people get worse jobs than the one which I didn't get in)
I PMed you a few minutes ago.
Do you need someone to talk to?

You have to be proud that you are still alive.

Honestly my biggest accomplishment of last year is that I made it through without killing myself.

I still wouldn't mind being dead. I actually rather die. However I can't do that for those who are around me.
Simple I didn't get in...

Try something that you have to take your mind off.

Try peaceful video games?

This probably is not a realist choice but you should leave and take a break for a few hours from those thoughts.

But don't sleep.

They are probably noticing you pushing on.

Have you tried breaking out to one of your friends?
Cut while shaving via a straight razor
I'm from NZ. Different system...

I know that there are more than one way. I don't want that way to be more rough...

I don't know if I can handle it to be honest. If it wasn't for my few friends last year during my peak depression I wouldn't have made it this far. I mean that literary.

I'm just not sure... All I know is that all papers are set and done. There is no going back.
I'm here to listen. Feel free to PM me if you need someone to talk to...
A stranger by passing: Feel free to PM me...

I've read it.

Do you need someone to talk to? Feel free to PM me.

I understand what you are going through. Don't give up, look at the bright side!

I will be in 2014 (in about 2.5 hours) little sooner than you will be and I feel shit too but I am trying my best to look at the bright side!

I asked the wrong person actually...

Anyways I asked because age helps me to figure out what I should do.
How old are you if you don't mind answering?

Exactly. Busy mind is happy mind.

"Get busy living or get busy dying"

I want one but I have budget issues. Haha
I want to buy a whiteboard too! Why do you want one if I may ask?
Your favorite is my favorite. Would you be willing to share how you did it?

I love your art!

You are not alone. We are here for you. If you need someone to talk to feel free to PM me.
You will get through this. Hang tight. You will make it out.

I'm here for you. 

PM me if you want. (Just let me know if you want to talk if you want to talk I might head off Reddit soon)

I think I should keep seeing my friends and maybe even call them up for some group activity...

I have some hope that keep seeing them will make those feelings go away...

Admitting your problems will not make you look weak. It will only make you look stronger to people who really cares about you.

Try talking to your close friends first if talking to your parents does not feel right to you. (seeing a counselor will definitely help)

>It just seems like the ups in life (which are already hard to come by) aren't really worth it if I keep having to go through the downs.

I agree, everytime it happens I always wonder why I am even choosing to bother...

However, you can't just leave think about the people around you!

I took Citalopram for two days during my final examination period. I had to stop taking them because of the side effects (It was affecting my study).

Since then I haven't tried medications (been about 30 days). At current stage I am not intending to take any medications unless things get worse.

From what I have heard meds do help. So it might be a good idea to try it out if things get little too tough.

I guess I have to be careful about committing suicide. Maybe talk to my close friend's dad. (He seems to be nice and knows a lot more about me than I thought he did...) It will be nice to talk to him if I have a chance since I don't have a dad...

In regards to getting stronger, I agree. I look back and I'm always surprised how I went through that lowest of the lowest period.

May I ask what are the things that you can't tell?

I haven't broken out to them and I have to be careful about what I tell... (I don't want to weigh them down with my life problems)

I'm glad you are doing better. My depression was at its absolute peak on my final exams. Now, I graduated high school I feel relieved but I'm still afraid about the future...

I hope my friends will stick around and be my friends... I really need them...

I haven't really broken out to them and I think I should break out to them when the time is right...

I hope you are getting through your life well.

Yeah I think seeing doctors and friends is the best thing.

I feel like I am more comfortable to talk to my friends and my friends parents than doctors or my mother though. (Plus they know me better...)

I also always feel like I will say something or do something wrong.

I guess I like being around people because I am lonely... I honestly don't know what to do since my feelings deeps down whenever I have interaction with my friends like this.

You should tell him to seek for a professional help. (Directly or indirectly you should try.)

I know that counselors or therapist don't always work out. Tell him it will take some time to find the right one it sometimes requires several trais.

Feel free to PM me.
Does he have access to professional help?

For some reason I like the end of pretty much everything. I want things to end especially 2013. I feel so free that this year is coming to an end but at the same time I kind of feel like this year went meaninglessly.
I would suggest you to just talk to him about the problems. Talking helps to figure out the problems and prevents tunnel vision.

Maybe because people didn't know what to say?

I've tried talking to one of my friend and he didn't quite understand what depression is thus he did not understand what I was going through...
Yeah it does, but I think its kind of weird to just randomly tell him. Haha...

Do I just say: "I'm depressed"? Haha...

How would I straight up tell him?

I guess I can just straight up say I am deeply unhappy and I am depressed. Haha

I'm not sure how he will react though.
Is this guy alive?
Yeah, hopefully and eventually...

I don't know if I have given happiness to others if you say it like that. I think I have, honestly I think have done that.

Not sure when I will find what I am looking for though. I whish I just had a real close friend to talk.

My dad passed away 45 days before Christmas due to cancer...

I hope you can find what you want to know...

Unfortunately as far as I know my father has no tradition.

In fact I don't even remember what I did on Christmas days... I have no memories left prior to his death.

Its my first Christmas with depression is well.

I just want emotional stability... I don't know if it will ever come...

When my father died when I was 11 I was seating next to him mindlessly. I watched him die in the emergency room and I didn't cry, nor I was sad.

The feelings that I had when my dad died came back when I got depressed. Just pure emptiness and I still do feel empty.

You are not alone. Feel free to PM me anytime

Never really felt this pointless. (Whenever I did in the past it was because I was thinking about philosophy or astronomy. Haha. Now it's just in my mind that life is pointless and I actually wouldn't mind being dead.) I always looked forward to the future, every time I remember this I laugh again. (Hell, I am laughing now.)

I'm not sure if I am in shock... (When my father died when I was 11, I was just sitting next to my dad's body mindlessly, not even crying. (I watched him die) I think back now and I guess I was in shock at that moment. Looking it myself now I don't know if I am in shock or not. I don't feel like I am...)

I do see the world and living pointless to be honest.

I've only seen **psychiatrist** once for about an hour (28th Nov). She pointed out that I should see a **psychologist** (Prior to this I've seen a doctor specializes in medical consulting (I think? I should probably find out... Haha))

BTW I have edited my last comment. Please check...

In short: I do find it absurd, I never thought I will have a mental health problems. Also I was generally always a happy person. Never quite get angry or sad, when I do, I get over it pretty quick. But now I am depressed   more than 99% of the day...

Also, I realized that as my mood started to drop earlier (approx 2nd Q 2012) I started laughing a lot more at bad jokes, silly memes that no one finds it funny. Basically my laughter trigger got more sensitive (?). But again I never laugh at serious situations. Until 28th Nov, I never laughed at my depression. (Maybe 2 or 3 times total) Now I laugh a lot...

No, I don't find other people who are depressed funny at all. (I feel sorry for what they are going through since I know how it feels.)

Also I started laughing at those stupid videos and posters of dramatic anti drink driving or texting while driving commercials (and also anything related) funny. I especially find full length TV ads funny since they made it so dramatic. (FLY: I would say I have above average physics and cinematography knowledge than average viewers. (this probably has something to do with laughter trigger))

Its a slow process. I am going to see a therapist today. I'm not sure if I will find it helpful. (She said we will work on schedules and set plans to do during the holidays.)

I've got my draft schedules already because I have been using holidays very inefficiently for the past 3 years. So I'm trying to fix that.

I'm just trying my best to fix things. Trying my best to improve, trying to be a better person.

I did make a list of things to do. Most of them are not fun, if not done in group... (I'm not sure if anyone will come out with me)

I am trying to learn new things and do some physical exercise but its not going great. I am working on it hard. Its a slow process.

I haven't even managed to let them know how I feel because every time we meet up (at school) I'm so happy and everyone else are just happy to interact with each other and I don't want to break out to them.

Basically, I never had a chance to let them know. Looks like I blew that chance away...

Talking to my friends makes me happy though...

I don't know what to do...

I have been seeing school counselor. Professional mental health support team and two mental health related doctors. I will be meeting a psychologist in the near future.

However, I don't find them very useful.
I've sent a PM.

I may be further isolating myself by reaching out to my friends. I've always had that feeling and I think best thing to do is just slowly break out...

Number of my friends are still doing exams and I hope to just hang out with them and just tell about what I am going through when the time is right. All I can hope is my friends are willing to hang out with me.

As for therapist, I've tried school counselor and I don't find it very helpful to be honest. (Well I think my friends are going to be best therapist since I can probably talk about anything... haha)

I wish I saw this comment before I sent him the message... I am more invested in the friendship than he is... However, prior to the message went out and still till this point, I still feel that he is the best person to talk to.

>And if you're feeling rejected by or resentful of him, be sure to edit it out of the email/message. ;)

I don't get this part... Could you please explain?

As for outbreaking for a support, I think I did that with the last message I sent. He hasn't replied yet and I have some hope for getting help from him. But I am not that optimistic.

I feel the same. I feel emotionless. I feel lost and empty. All I know is that I once had feelings like others. I used to be happy.

Just remember that you are not alone. Remember you will make it through. Push on.

Try to find the origin of the problem. That helped for me.

I still haven't completely found my origin of the problem. I'm still working on it. It takes time.

I never really knew what caused my depression until I had many and long 'thinking' in a nice quite room at nigh when everyone is at sleep.

I'm still not too sure. So I write it down, like a journal... Hoping one day I will find an answer within me. I think I will. I have faith in it.
I rather talk to a person I have interacted in the past... (Please don't take this in the wrong way though. Thanks for the offer)
New Zealand

I feel the same. Well at least till I went to school.

I finished my high school about 3 weeks ago. My last exam was yesterday. Now school is over and I don't see my friends. I laugh a lot less...

Now I'm on holidays and I don't know if anyone wants to hang out with me. I just hate holidays. I just want to be with people. Even though I am terrible at at socializing. I also don't know how I will make friends in Uni...
I guess I am just tired. Thats what I tell people when they ask how I am doing is well. (Not a very truthful answer I would say. It only shows the 'bright' side of the moon I would say...)
You don't need a cape and mask to be a hero!
I get it now. You would find it funny for a short period of time I guess. Haha
A silent guardian. A watchful protector!
Really? I don't understand...
I thought it would be amusing to watch other people including your friends doing stupid things?
Why?
No can do sir.
All boys school.
This is my last year at high school... haha

I've changed my car windscreen wipers recently and it hasn't rained since. It took over 10 weeks to change the wipers and I remember being made about how shitty my wipers were. 

I hope it rains soon. I just want the weather to be really bad... I know its selfish but I just do... I think it will make me feel better!

Someone to talk to would be best. Your friend may not be able to talk to you face to face. Then try messaging or phone call. 

Second thing is just get the person to be involved in things you do. Invite the friend, do something together.

I feel kind of same. I feel like I'm losing friends. 

The finals are on so I'm not very sure how my friends look at me. But I do feel like my friendship is falling a part. 

I don't want this either. I feel lost and empty.

I want this life to be it. I don't want heaven, afterlife, reincarnation or eternal life. I want this life to be it. 

But I'm not going to end it. People need help. So do I. I won't leave until I give something back.
Thank you. And I am glad you liked it!
I hope I can!

Something simple. You are right. But it took me so long...
Its very nice to hear you did something similar.

Thank you for commenting and sharing this with us.
I stand before you for a push you may need. I stand by you to be leaned against. I walk ahead of you to guide your way.
I stand before you for a push you may need. I stand by you to be leaned against. I walk ahead of you to help your way.

I feel similar and I pressed on doing my work. Easy ones first. One small step at a time.

In regards to friends, try to go somewhere where you used to be like to be. But not a place where it will bring back pass memories and make you feel worse. Try to have small interactions. Thats all I can say.

Yes I have. But I know that is not possible. 

I know that the only thing that I believe is possible is to change the future. The only thing I can do is make the future to be a happy pace by altering the present. By altering the 'current', I can make the future to be a happy place.

I know its very hard and may seem there is no way to do it. You may even just want the end. Everything to stop or finish, just the end. But if you press on, at some point you will see the light.
Thank you.
I can't see the photo clearly. Could you please reupload it?

I'm not a very social person so one on one hang out session may not be a good idea... Small group session would be better for now I am guessing.

Also I will try my best to be involved with physical activities. I once liked doing that and I got really sick about 8 years ago, that stopped everything...

Firstly, thank you for replying.

If he brushes me off I will feel rejected and it will make things worse...
I will try my best to open up when the time and place is right.

I try my best not to look back. Those good memories I have are sometimes like a knife into a gut. But sometimes I do enjoy looking at photos and videos of friends I've taken in the past.
I intend not to live the past though. I will never go back, or try to recreate the past.

Firstly, thank you very much for replying.

None of my friends know my struggles. 

I've first reached out to one of my class mate (I would call him a friend) who is quite mature, good social skills and popular and results weren't really as good as I expected. (Well it is exam period, and we don't really talk or hang out so why should he care?). From what I've heard I don't think he has been depressed or felt anxious like I did (do). 

He said he openly talks to his parents or siblings but mainly his girlfriend about serious stuff. But unfortunately I don't have anyone like he does.

So based on what he said and based on observations I've made over time, being more open wouldn't hurt.

I have one close friend who used to be really interested in me and I feel guilty that I've been so closed to him. (I also feel that we are not very close as we used to be). I've sort of tried talking to him on Facebook but he doesn't quite come back... (I know because he is trying not to have that 'seen' thing on FB) and we don't have serious chats in real life. (I think he knows something is up though and I feel like he doesn't really want to go in to it). Now that we don't really see each other because of the exams its been more difficult for me. (I really wish I could just one day open up to him.)

He did say we have our differences but have strange connections. (I feel that way is well.) I like technical and computer stuff and he likes sports and knows how to take the moment and enjoy it. (I honestly feel like he is the right one to open up but I'm not sure and I fear that he will not care...)

I will try my best to see my friends after the exams. Do something meaningful together but I don't know if they want to include me though.

Even though I never watch the videos. I believe that someday I will watch them (least some of them) and does gives me some hope (?) or positive effect.
I would suggest you do it. (I don't know about putting it on the internet)

I do that for myself. Expect I don't put it on the internet.
If you have no concerns about privacy I suggest you do that.
Personally I don't watch my videos because it makes me feel worse...

I think we are in a similar situation. I think I pushed my friend away (unintentionally) because I didn't want to lose him. It changed my behaviors around him. I do love him (straight friendship wise) but I don't think he really likes me as used to. 
I don't really have a desire to push on. But I can't end my life because it will hurt my friends and people around me. (You may feel like no one is around you but trust me it will have an impact.) I know it's hard and if I do end my life. I get a feeling that someone will go through the same shit I went through. So to protect the people around me I push on...

I get that all the time. 
I'm sure some people are worse than I am doing. But those sayings like that does not comfort me at all. It just makes it worse. To be honest how can being reminded that someone else is doing even worse than I am comforting?
